title: Hr Services Analyst
description:
Who are we?Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company, operating over 260 data centers across the globe. Digital leaders harness Equinix's trusted platform to bring together and interconnect foundational infrastructure at software speed. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners, and possibilities to scale with agility, speed the launch of digital services, deliver world-class experiences, and multiply their value, while supporting their sustainability goals.A career at Equinix means you will collaborate on work that impacts the world and be surrounded by endless opportunities to learn new skills and grow in varied directions. We embrace diversity in thought and contribution and are committed to providing an equitable work environment that is foundational to our core values as a company and is vital to our success.Job SummaryEquinix is seeking a dynamic and proactive HR Services Analyst – AMER Benefits to join our team. In this role, you will oversee and administer benefits processes across AMER countries, including Brazil, Peru, Chile, Mexico, Colombia, and initially focusing on the US and Canada. You will serve as a key resource for employees, addressing their benefits inquiries and collaborating with partners and insurers to ensure effective administration of various benefits plans.As an HR Services Analyst, you will work closely with diverse, multicultural teams, including payroll, Centers of Excellence (COE), HR Business Advisors (HRBA), and management. You will also contribute to global and regional projects, which will involve creating and updating documentation to enhance our benefits offerings. Your proactive approach, critical thinking skills, and commitment to ensuring a seamless end-to-end process will be vital to your success in this role. Join us in shaping a positive benefits experience for our employees!Responsibilities:
HR Services Execution:
Serve as a highly skilled specialist in HR services, executing all processes and addressing queries up to Tier 2. You will also assist with Tier 3 inquiries, ensuring a high level of service and support. Provide exceptional support to employees by addressing Tier 2 questions and requests through our Case Management System. Your commitment to customer service will enhance the employee experience.Benefits Administration:
Oversee the daily administration of employee benefit programs, including health insurance, life insurance, meal vouchers, and other allowances across AMER countries.Process Expertise:
Develop a deep understanding of end-to-end processes, enabling you to assist seamlessly at every stage of complex workflows. Your insights will support the entire region and enhance operational efficiency.Collaboration:
Work closely with internal teams, external vendors, and brokers to ensure the smooth operation of our benefits programs. Your collaborative spirit will foster strong partnerships that drive success.Knowledge Management:
Create, improve, and maintain internal documentation related to processes, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and Process Maps. Attend project sessions to learn from others, ask insightful questions, and ensure comprehensive knowledge capture throughout the documentation process.Content Development:
Develop and update HR articles and guides on benefit-related matters, ensuring employees have access to accurate and relevant information.Enrollment and Auditing:
Ensure employees are enrolled in their benefits programs and conduct regular audits of benefits data to maintain accuracy and compliance.Vendor Relations:
Collaborate closely with benefits vendors and brokers to resolve issues and optimize service delivery, ensuring employees receive the best possible support.SLA and KPI Management:
Understand and execute on Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring operational goals are met and high-quality service is delivered.Customer Service Excellence:
Provide outstanding customer service by delivering high-quality resolutions and consistent support for standard processes, following documented work instructions and guidelines.Compliance Adherence:
Understand and adhere to compliance requirements for SOX, Employee Data Governance, and other policy mandates, ensuring practices meet regulatory standards.Global and Regional Projects:
Participate in global and regional projects, contributing insights and expertise. Attend project sessions to learn from colleagues, share best practices, and ensure knowledge is captured and documented effectively.Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.Language:
Fluent in English;
Spanish is a strong plus.Negotiation Skills:
Demonstrated solid knowledge and expertise in negotiation, with the ability to advocate effectively for employee benefits.Experience:
Previous experience in benefits administration in the US and Canada is highly desirable and will set you apart as a candidate.Equinix is an equal opportunity employer. our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work. description:
Sobre a ZippiA Zippi tem como missão ajudar a impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades. Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito, permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa mais saudável para suas operações.Desde o nosso lançamento, alcançamos a lucratividade e experimentamos um crescimento exponencial. Hoje, processamos mais de R$ 3,4 bilhões em pagamentos por ano e estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de crédito no mercado brasileiro de MPEs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 1,6 trilhão ao ano. Se você busca uma oportunidade de causar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena, em uma das fintechs que mais cresce em mercados emergentes, enfrentando um desafio multibilionário - a Zippi é o lugar certo pra você.Sobre o TimeA área de Finance da Zippi vive um momento de consolidação e evolução. Com o amadurecimento da operação, estamos internalizando processos que antes eram terceirizados e redesenhando rotinas, com o objetivo de aumentar controle, eficiência e acurácia das informações financeiras na velocidade que nosso estágio atual exige.Os principais focos são:
automatizar o contas a pagar, implementar controles robustos de cash management e melhorar continuamente a experiência dos nossos times internos nas interações com a área. Ao mesmo tempo, você será peça-chave na evolução da área de Finance — apoiando automações, liderando melhorias e implementando soluções que deixem nossos processos mais ágeis, inteligentes e prontos para escalar com a Zippi. alguém que busque incansavelmente a excelência, tenha ambição para crescer, entregue com altíssimo nível de qualidade, pense como dono e trate seu trabalho como missão crítica.Suas responsabilidades no dia a dia:

description:
"al final con empeño las cosas acaban saliendo bien, y Brasil es un país ideal para intentarlo en estos momentos." HoyarquiPARADOS entrevistamos a Jon, arquitecto español que se encuentra actualmente trabajando en Brasil. Os dejamos con su experiencia:
"al final con empeño las cosas acaban saliendo bien, y Brasil es un país ideal para intentarlo en estos momentos." HoyarquiPARADOS entrevistamos a Jon, arquitecto español que se encuentra actualmente trabajando en Brasil. Os dejamos con su experiencia:
Hola Jon, dinos ¿Qué situación te hizo tomar la decisión de dar el salto? Una vez terminada la carrera, me salió una beca para hacer prácticas de trabajo durante seis meses en el extranjero. Sin dudarlo, y teniendo en cuenta la situación en España, busque una empresa en Brasil que estuviera interesada en acogerme durante ese período y me marché.Tuve relativa facilidad para encontrar la empresa, ya que un compañero que había vivido en Brasil me pasó un par de referencias, y teniendo en cuenta que suponía mano de obra gratis, pocas empresas podían rechazarlo.¿Cómo fueron los inicios? Facilidades y problemas al llegar. A pesar de la facilidad para encontrar el despacho donde trabajar, el tema del visado fue un quebradero de cabeza. Existe una ley brasileña que impide a las empresas contratar a más de un extranjero por cada brasileño.Además, los trámites para regularizar a un empleado, incluso uno en prácticas temporales, es muy engorroso y si la empresa no es relativamente grande suele costar que se metan en semejante berenjenal.Por si eso fuera poco, los despachos de arquitectura suelen contratar a pocos empleados fijos aquí, ya que la movilidad es bastante grande, y suelen hacer contratos tipo freelance incluso a los locales, lo cual dificulta enormemente poder gestionar un visado de trabajo .Además, los consulados de Brasil en España no son muy colaborativos, te obligan a desplazarte hasta Madrid o Barcelona para cualquier cosa, no responden mails ni teléfono y ofrecen pocas soluciones.Total, después de muchos intentos y probar diferentes opciones, tuve que viajar a Brasil como turista (para lo cual también es necesario juntar algunos papeles).Tuve la suerte de tener un amigo allí que me acogió hasta que encontré un piso para residir, cosa que es también bastante engorrosa y muy cara en las principales ciudades del país.Por lo demás, la adaptación fue muy buena. La gente es extraordinariamente amable y te ayuda siempre que puede. El idioma no es un problema, en poco más de un mes me comunicaba sin problemas con la gente y en el trabajo, y hasta entonces, el portuñol resulta bastante práctico.¿Cuántotiempo llevas trabajando de arquitecto en Brasil? Hasta la fecha llevo casi ocho meses en Brasil y la verdad estoy muy contento. Conseguí permanecer en el despacho en el que hice las prácticas, donde hago lo que me gusta.Tocamos temas tanto de urbanismo como de arquitectura, encargos y concursos, con lo que el trabajo suele ser variado. Aún así, predominan los proyectos de concurso público relacionados con las intervenciones y mejora de las comunidades o favelas .Actualmente se están llevando a cabo muchas obras relacionadas con los eventos deportivos próximos, Copa del Mundo, etc., pero muchos de estos encargos están adjudicados a dedo, por lo que los despachos que pueden aprovechar esta oportunidad son la minoría. La corrupción está, aquí también, a la orden del día.Por lo demás, como sucedió en España, está habiendo unboom en la construcción de complejos turísticos en la costa, pero este tipo de obras (bastante discutibles moral y medioambientalmente) suelen llevarlas en su gran mayoría las constructoras.¿Notas mucha diferencia en la forma de proyectar?En general, la calidad de la arquitectura en Brasil esmuy inferior a la de España, al igual que su formación, exceptuando casos aislados.Ello hace que muchos despachos desarrollen un trabajo de nivel medio-bajo y eso produce que otros que podrían aspirar a hacerlo mejor no lo hacen por falta de "competencia", ¿para qué esforzarse más si sabes que el de al lado no va a hacerlo mejor que tú?Aún así, esa mentalidad está cambiando poco a poco y la llegada demuchos extranjeros (especialmente europeos) al mundo laboral brasileño está haciendo que el proceso se acelere y el nivel de exigencia mejore.¿Te consideras bien remunerado? En estos momentos estoy cobrando un sueldo bajo, como empleado junior, pero es lo justo para llegar a final de mes sin apuros yno me quejo. Las expectativas de mejora son buenas.¿Qué grandes diferencias encuentras en la forma de vida con respecto a España? Para mi, la mayor diferencia con España es "el ritmo ". Compartimos muchísimas cosas culturalmente y salvando las distancias el estilo de vida es similar, aún así, el tópico de esa despreocupación y tranquilidad brasileñas no son del todo mentira.A veces resulta un incordio tanta tranquilidad (como cuando las cajeras del supermercado no van más rápido ni se estresan lo más mínimo a pesar de tener colas inmensas de gente esperando), pero uno se acostumbra a ello.Para otras cosas, tiene su lado positivo, existe muchísimo menos estrés en el trabajo y la vida se lleva con más sosiego y calma.¿Conoces muchos españoles por tu zona? Como en todos los rincones del mundo, y más ahora que todos los jóvenes (y no tan jóvenes) estamos huyendo del país, hay una gran cantidad de españoles por Brasil, tanto de intercambio de estudios (la mayoría todavía) como trabajando.Existen grupos de facebook de españoles donde la gente se pone en contacto para cosas varias, desde quedadas para ver los partidos de futbol hasta para buscar pisos de alquiler.¿Nos recomendarías algún medio, para encontrar trabajo allí, desdeEspaña? Creo que es complicado encontrar trabajo desde España en Brasil, aunque no imposible claro. A pesar de que hay mucho trabajo, se echa mucha mano de estudiantes en prácticas no remuneradas, lo cual disminuye la oferta.Lo mejor suele ser presentarse en el país e ir un poco puerta a puerta buscando trabajo. Como en cualquier sitio, no es una tarea sencilla, pero por la experiencia de conocidos, la mayoría acaban encontrando alguna cosa.Como comentaba anteriormente, los grupos de facebook pueden ser prácticos, siempre hay gente que conoce a gente que puede acabar echándote un cable!¿Qué le dirías a un arquitecto que no encuentra trabajo enEspaña? Animo a aquellos que no encuentran soluciones en España y que tienen recelo a salir a buscarse la vida por ahí a que lo hagan.A pesar de que dar el paso suele costar un poco, al final con empeño las cosas acaban saliendo bien, y Brasil es un país ideal para intentarlo en estos momentos.Existe un gran volumen de trabajo y aprecio por los arquitectos españoles, y aunque aún no hay muchas facilidades para regularizar el tema del visado y eso, parece que se están moviendo para cambiar eso también.Por otro lado, mencionar que el mejor sitio para buscar un buen empleo, en cuanto a calidad de lo que se hace y la seriedad de los despachos (tema salarios, etc. también) es São Paulo .Río de Janeiro suele ser el destino principal de la gente cuando viene a Brasil, y quizá precisamente por ello, el mercado está un poco más saturado, aunque también hay bastante empleo a raíz de la copa, las olimpiadas, etc.En general, esas dos son las ciudades con más movimiento, aunque otras ciudades del sur también son buenas para intentar encontrar algo. El norte del país es más pobre y no hay tanto trabajo en el campo de la arquitectura.¿Cómo ves el futuro de los arquitectos a nivelnacional e internacional? En cuanto a la situación de la arquitectura en España y en el mundo, aunque mi opinión no sea más válida que la de ningún otro, opino que no va a ser más lo que hemos conocido hasta el momento. En España va a tener que transformarse en algo mucho más relacionado con conservar y mejorar lo que ya tenemos que con construir cosas nuevas.En mi opinión, es el momento de echar la mirada atrás y ver lo que ha quedado del trabajo hecho los últimos años, las ciudades que hemos construido, si son o no el ideal que podíamos tener en nuestra cabezas y ver qué podemos hacer para equilibrar unas ciudades que han crecido sin medida y sin control.Pensar nuevas soluciones para problemas pasados, muy vinculado con la sostenibilidad y las nuevas tecnologías, empezar a introducir en la arquitectura los avances hechos en esos campos en los últimos años y que por pereza y falta de visión no han sido incluidos en gran parte de lo hecho.A nivel mundial, es difícil decir, seguramente predominarán la arquitectura empresarial y vinculada solo al crecimiento económico, sin tener en cuenta el crecimiento social, como viene siendo el caso.Aún así, estamos en una época de cambio, de cambio en muchas cosas, y también en la arquitectura, y espero que muchas de las reclamaciones de libertad, participación, transparencia y concienciación que se están solicitando a nivel político acaben impregnando también en la arquitectura, y se convierta una profesión y un ejercicio mucho más concienciado, participativo y social de lo que es hoy en día.¿Te arrepientes de haber tomado la decisión de irte? ¿Tienes fecha de vuelta? No me arrepiento en absoluto de haber salido del país, tuve la oportunidad de hacerlo con un soporte que me facilito el paso, pero lo hubiera hecho igualmente de no haber sido así.El destino de esa aventura no deja de ser decisión y preferencia de cada uno, qué cosas cada uno quiere explorar y conocer. Para mí Brasil ha sido un destino ideal, estoy aprendiendo muchas cosas que desconocía y que me interesan cantidad.Tengo un trabajo del que vivir y con el que disfruto y he hecho muchas amistades, en el trabajo y fuera de él. Es un buen lugar, y creo que cada vez lo será más, para buscar un camino alternativo a la apatía y el desempleo.***Queremos darle las gracias Jon por prestarse a colaborar con nosotros desinteresadamente y compartir su experiencia con nosotros. Si te ha gustado compártelo con tus amigos, y si eres un arquiEXPATRIADO que quiere contarnos su experiencia y servir de ayuda a muchos ponte en contacto con nosotros.Si quieres encontrar trabajo como arquitecto en Brasil, será muy necesario que aprendasPortugués. Si ya hablas español no te costará mucho trabajo, pero algo tendrás que estudiar.Si quieresaprender portugués te recomendamos el siguiente curso online:
Ver CursoCURSOS Y MASTERS PARA ARQUITECTOS Si estás interesado en Cursos o Másteres, échale un vistazo a nuestra selección de programas de formación específicos para arquitectos .VER TODOS LOS CURSOS SEGURO QUE TE INTERESA:

title: Commercial Planning And Sales Enablement Analyst
description:
Company OverviewIf you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too:
Your Path, Our Journey.We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.#LI-HybridTeam OverviewYou will be part of DriverLAB, an innovation center in Brazil 100% focused on partner drivers. This transformative initiative is designed to provide greater well-being to partner drivers, with care solutions that enhance their earnings, reduce costs, promote greater access to services, and enable more Brazilians to drive and thrive through the platform.Additionally, your role will have a strong focus on sustainable initiatives, promoting the democratization of access to electric vehicles. We believe that expanding the adoption of electric cars is a key step toward a more sustainable and efficient urban mobility ecosystem. Through this position, you will be part of projects that drive the growth of sustainable transport solutions, empowering drivers and contributing to the reduction of the carbon footprint in urban areas.Role ResponsibilitiesJob Description:
We are looking for an analytical, strategic, and highly communicative individual to join our Commercial Planning and Sales Enablement team. This position is crucial to strengthen the sales team's performance through optimized processes, structured commercial planning, strategic content, and data analysis.The role involves identifying improvement opportunities in the sales journey, proposing solutions alongside the Product team, supporting strategic sales planning, and ensuring all initiatives are reflected in documentation, training, and performance reports.Responsibilities:
Diagnose bottlenecks and opportunities in sales processes, proposing practical, data-driven solutions.Request and monitor improvements with the Product team that directly impact the efficiency and conversion of the sales team, and test these improvements before wide adoption.Develop, organize, and maintain sales support materials (pitch decks, playbooks, battle cards, FAQs, among others).Update and structure documentation such as process flowcharts, training manuals, and onboarding materials.Conduct regular training sessions for sales team development and onboarding, focusing on agility and consistent performance.Ensure the strategic and correct use of commercial tools (CRM, automations, content library, etc.).Support commercial planning by creating market analyses, sales projections, and performance reports.Monitor commercial KPIs and suggest initiatives that directly impact the productivity and conversion rates of the sales team.Generate reports and insights for decision-making, optimizing sales strategies and commercial campaigns.Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure alignment of messages, processes, and objectives.Promote a culture of commercial excellence, sharing best practices and continuous learning.Role QualificationsRequirements:
Previous experience in Commercial Planning, Sales Enablement, Sales, Commercial Operations, or related areas.Well-organized with strong attention to processes and documentation.Ability to transform strategies into objective, functional materials that can be applied in the team's daily activities.Knowledge of tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.Ability to conduct training sessions, presentations, and interactions with different audiences.Analytical and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Advanced Excel skills are a must.Intermediate English for reading, material creation, interaction with global tools, and participation in occasional meetings.Desirable:
Familiarity with sales methodologies (SPIN, Sandler, Challenger, etc.).Knowledge of query languages like SQL or SOQL (Salesforce) for direct performance analysis and decision-making support.Experience with Business Intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, or Looker) for dashboard creation and data analysis.Experience in planning commercial campaigns and go-to-market strategies.Behavioral Profile:
Proactivity and autonomy.Clear and collaborative communication.Ability to work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders.Ownership mindset and focus on high-quality execution.Curiosity and willingness to constantly learn.Flexibility and adaptability to work in dynamic environments with frequent changes and continuous process evolution.Strategic thinking and analytical vision to identify opportunities and propose high-impact solutions.EEO StatementWe create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.Diversity & InclusionDiversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday;
it is a non-negotiablevalue of who we are today.We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come. Participate in comprehensive studies to craft and refine new AML rules, enhancing the effectiveness of our control mechanisms and procedural frameworks.AML Monitoring Execution:

Fluent in English with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.Problem-Solving:
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, attentive to detail and the capacity to work under pressure.Fundamental understanding of prompt engineering:
showcasing an ability to effectively interact with and utilize AI technologies.Nice-to-Have:
US Compliance Knowledge:
Familiarity with US compliance standards and AML regulations.Data-Driven Analysis:
Work with data collection, information management, and the development of dashboards using Looker. Experience with other platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, and Metabase is a plus.Global and Local Regulatory Expertise:
Strong understanding of both local and global regulatory requirements, including Registration, Know Your Customer (KYC), and Anti-Money Laundering/Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF) protocols.Automation and Optimization:
Utilize appropriate tools and scripts to automate processes and optimize routines within the AML/CFT department.AI-Enhanced Solutions:
Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT and machine learning algorithms to streamline data analysis and decision-making in the AML/CTF department.The Future We See:
At CloudWalk, we envision a future where AI empowers every field to reach new heights:
- People teams leveraging AI to transform talent acquisition and employee development.- Marketing professionals creating data-driven, AI-powered campaign strategies.- Customer Success teams enhancing client experiences with intelligent solutions.- Risk analysts combining human expertise with AI to navigate complexities.- Designers collaborating with AI to push creative boundaries.Join us at CloudWalk, where we’re not just engineering solutions;
we’re building a smarter, AI-driven future for payments—together.By applying for this position, your data will be processed as per Cloudwalk's Privacy Policy that you can readhere in Portugueseandhere in English.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Impact Analyst, Regenerative Agriculture
description:
Everyone deserves the opportunity to build a better future. This simple idea has been at the heart of TechnoServe’s work around the world for over 50 years. TechnoServe is a pioneer in leveraging the power of businesses and markets to create sustainable pathways out of poverty.The low-income communities in which we work are full of enterprising people. Their small-scale farms and businesses are the keys to economic development. But they face many challenges:
low literacy, lack of access to jobs and markets, unpredictable political dynamics, and, increasingly, the effects of climate change. Without resources to combat threats like volatile weather patterns, worsening natural disasters, and crop and livestock diseases, these small-scale producers face lower incomes and higher risks as they struggle to earn a good living.TechnoServe is meeting this challenge with a bold commitment to help create a people-, nature-, and climate-positive world. Our Regenerate 30 initiative launched at COP27 aims to achieve the following impact by 2030:
30 million people with increased resilience, 30 million tons of CO2e mitigated or sequestered, 30 million acres of land under sustainable management or improved conservation, and $300 million in private sector investment. The initiative will drive over $1 billion in financial benefits for smallholder farmers and businesses. Innovating with corporate partners to transform their global supply chains across their entire sourcing footprint while they work towards achieving net-zero commitments is critical to achieving our Regenerate 30 vision.Program OverviewTechnoServe has been selected as a preferred strategic sustainability partner by a major global Fast-Moving Consumer Goods company to deliver its ambitious corporate commitment on regenerative agriculture (“Regen Ag”), also contributing to its net-zero carbon agenda. Partnering with an industry-leading company to drive the transformation towards regenerative farming systems across its global supply chains is directly aligned with TechnoServe’s Regenerate 30 vision. We will help strengthen the resilience of the farmers and businesses that operate within the market system, while also contributing to the overall sustainability of that system by delivering positive outcomes on soil health, water resources, and biodiversity.The donor has made a corporate commitment to protecting and regenerating 1.5 million hectares of land, forest, and oceans by 2030 and has partnered with TechnoServe to deploy the Regenerative Agriculture Program, inspiring and supporting farmers and agribusinesses to engage in the journey towards regenerative production systems.This global program, funded through 2027, is an opportunity to work with a leading company to demonstrate that there is a future for a better, low-carbon, biodiverse, and profitable approach to farming. The program will work together with the donor’s suppliers across countries and a variety of food ingredients and will make meaningful contributions to TechnoServe’s Regenerate 30 impact goals. This will require us to work with the leading regenerative experts and practitioners in farming communities around the world, supporting them to drive bottom-up change based on the local context. The program has a global scope, which creates a unique opportunity to compare new regenerative farming practices and to share insights and lessons across contexts.Job SummaryTechnoServe’s Regenerative Agriculture Implementation Team is seeking a highly motivated Impact Analyst to support the implementation of regenerative agriculture projects with suppliers across Latin America & Europe. Reporting to the Impact & Finance Manager and receiving strategic direction from the Program Director, the Analyst will collaborate closely with the Agriculture Manager, GHG accounting specialist, and local agronomists. The Analyst will be responsible for executing the program’s Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) processes, focused on quantifying environmental and financial outcomes for farmers.Key metrics include Greenhouse Gasses (GHG) emissions reduction, soil health improvement, water use efficiency, biodiversity restoration, and improvements in farmer livelihoods.The Impact Analyst will play a pivotal role in delivering a robust MRV system aligned with the donor’s regenerative agriculture framework. The Analyst’s primary focus will be on supporting the Brazil project, ensuring delivery of impact goals and alignment with global priorities, supplier engagement, and the business case for regenerative transition.Primary functions & Responsibilities:
Impact Analysis & Reporting:
Participates actively in the data collection process for farm-level data and annual results of the regenerative agriculture projectActs as a point of contact for MRV implementation—liaising across internal TechnoServe teams, agronomist experts, implementation partners, and local data providersSupports management of MRV partners responsible for performing specific on-the-ground analyses that validate regenerative farming practicesConducts farmer economic business case analysis and validation, to support farmer practice adoption and as input for donor reporting (e.G., financial modeling of farmer practice adoption, break-even analyses, cash flow implications for regen practices)Analyzes farm-level data and soil analysis results (with input from technical partners), calculates impact indicators, and supports baseline and annual reports. Key indicators include GHG emissions reduction, soil health improvement, water use efficiency, biodiversity restoration, and farmer livelihoods improvementContributes to the delivery of MRV, including preparation of standard and custom reports to communicate program outcomes and impact to stakeholders, ensuring data quality and audit readinessProvides technical expertise and support to project teams and farmers on methodologies, tools, and best practices for impact measurement, and setting up digital systems for data management and impact dashboardsContributes to developing and refining MRV protocols and standards to ensure alignment with organizational goals and industry best practices.Documents best practices, success stories, and lessons learned from program implementationCollaborates with internal and external stakeholders to collect, analyze, and synthesize findings to inform decision-making and program optimizationProject Management support (secondary priority):
Monitors progress against program milestones;
propose course corrections as neededDevelops financial models and bottom-up budgets that align strategically with work plans, targets, and deliverables (e.G., break-even analyses, cash flow implications for regen practices)Prepares specific reports as required by the Program Manager and donor, or to help respond to program incidents as they occurOther duties, as assignedBasic QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Environmental Sciences, Data Science, Economics, or related field.At least three years of related professional experience in impact measurement, sustainability reporting, or MRV systems—preferably in agriculture or climate projects, OR a Master's degree plus one year of experience.Proven experience in monitoring and evaluation, impact assessment, or sustainability reporting, preferably in the agriculture sector.Detail-oriented with strong analytical toolkit;
advanced Excel (and similar) required. Proficiency in advanced data management and analysis tools is a plus.Preferred QualificationsFamiliarity with agriculture, sustainability, or climate topics;
direct regenerative agriculture knowledge is a plus.Experience with carbon accounting (Cool Farm Tool, etc.) is highly desirable.Experience working in cross-functional and multicultural teams across various geographic regions.Prior experience writing and editing donor-facing deliverables.Required Languages:
Fluency in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish is a plus.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
Excellent communication skills for distilling complex analyses into clear, actionable presentations and briefings for both field and corporate audiences.Proven team player with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. Has a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a can-do attitude.Strong project management skills, including anticipating demand and managing multiple tasks and projects while meeting tight deadlines. Ability to work independently and remotely, and effectively manage multiple tasks and deadlines.Note:
This is a remote position based in the Latin America/Caribbean region. Candidates must have work authorization in the country from which they are applying. Application materials should be submitted in English for further consideration.We encourage all qualified individuals who share TechnoServe'svision of improving the lives of others through proven business solutions to apply.With our commitment to diversity, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer andaffirmative action employerand do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, color, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, HIV/AIDS status, protected veteran status, disability and all other protected classes.We are also proud of our commitment to protecting staff, partners, and beneficiaries from abuse and exploitation and thoroughly vet all final candidates through rigorous background and reference checks.If you have a disability that affects your ability to use our online system to apply for a position at TechnoServe please contact the Human Resources call .Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with DisabilitiesThis employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Process Mining Sênior
description:
Quem SomosA Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais:
Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.O que esperar de nósPessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam:
Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!Buscamos um profissional com experiência em Análise de Dados, como Engenheiro de Dados ou Cientista de Dados. Experiência comprovada em mineração e análise de processos usando Celonis ou ferramentas semelhantes de mineração de processos.O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalhoVocê trabalhará em uma equipe Agile (planejamento de sprint, revisões, retrospectivas).Você trabalhará na preparação de dados provenientes de diversos sistemas de TI, desenvolvendo o modelo de dados usando scripts SQL e criando protótipos de análise de dashboard em uma ferramenta de Mineração de Processos.Explorará e oferecerá soluções para os negócios com base nas capacidades da ferramenta e nas necessidades empresariais.Colaborará com diferentes áreas de negócios e equipes de suporte de TI ao redor do mundo.O que você precisa ter:
Linguagens de Programação:
Proficiência em linguagens como Python e SQL;
Gerenciamento de Banco de Dados:
Sólido entendimento do Snowflake, SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais;
Processamento de Dados:
Conhecimento em processos e ferramentas de ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga);
Tecnologias de TI:
Inteligência Artificial (IA), Machine Learning;
Computação em Nuvem:
Familiaridade com plataformas em nuvem como AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud;
Ferramentas de Big Data:
Experiência com ferramentas como Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Tableau e Power BI;
Conhecimento Fundamental de Negócios:
Sistemas SAP, Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Contas a Receber e Contas a Pagar;
Certificações Relevantes:
Certificações em engenharia de dados, computação em nuvem ou ferramentas e tecnologias específicas.Onde você vai trabalhar?No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.IDIOMASInglês Avançado é essencial (será testado).

Dar suporte na realização de atividades administrativas e de compras de material indireto, analisando dados de planilhas e desenhos técnicos, solicitando cotações junto a fornecedores e lançando informações de controle no sistema e demais atividades em apoio ao Comprador de materiais indiretos;

description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional altamente qualificado para a posição de Gelataio, se você tem os requisitos abaixo e acha que a vaga serve para você, se inscreva e venha fazer parte da Ofner!Você será responsável por produzir e criar sorvetes e gelatos artesanais deliciosos e únicos, utilizando ingredientes frescos e de alta qualidade. Além disso, também será responsável por servir nossos clientes com cortesia e profissionalismo, garantindo que tenham uma experiência agradável.Requisitos:
- Experiência em produção de gelato e/ou sorvetes;
- Atendimento ao cliente e vendas A&B;
- Ensino médio Completo;
Atividades:
- Produzir gelatos diariamente, garantindo 16 cubas cheias e cremosas, dentro do padrão;
- Manter a estação limpa e organizada, atendendo os padrões de qualidade;
- Verificar a temperatura adequada dos equipamentos na entrada e na saída, garantindo a qualidade do produto;
- Manter o atendimentoestabelecido pelo padrão Ofner, promovendo a fidelização dos clientes;
- Atender corretamente, explicando a composição dos produtos;
- Fazer a gestão do estoque de matéria prima passando os pedidos para o responsável da loja diariamente.Modelo de Contração:
- CLT- Escala 6X1- Horário flexívelBenefícios:
- Vale Refeição/Alimentação - Em um cartão de bandeira Visa!- Total Pass:
Descontos em diversas academias e apps esportivos;

- SalaryFits – Descontos em parceiros de Educação para que possa investir na sua formação e carreira;
- Desconto CINEMARK;
- Assistência Médica;
- Assistência Odontológica;
- Seguro de Vida;
- PLR;
- VT;
- SESC;
- Entre outros.Estamos ansiosos para receber sua candidatura!Atendimento ao cliente, vendas A&BExperiência em produção de gelato e/ou sorvetesSabores que inspiram históriasHá mais de 70 anos, a Ofner transforma ingredientes em memórias e memórias em momentos únicos.Nossa história é feita de pessoas, de cuidado artesanal e da busca constante por encantar com o que fazemos de melhor:
criar sabores que acolhem, surpreendem e fazem parte da vida das pessoas.Desde o início, acreditamos que o sabor é uma forma de expressão. É por isso que nossos produtos carregam mais do que técnica e qualidade — eles trazem alma. Da vitrine às embalagens, dos bastidores à mesa do cliente, tudo é feito com intenção, afeto e atenção aos detalhes.Nossas criações atravessam diferentes momentos do dia e da vida. Temos orgulho de oferecer uma linha completa de produtos:
salgados, panificados, chocolates, confeitaria, bebidas, gelato e presenteáveis. Cada categoria tem seu ritmo, sua beleza e sua história. E todas compartilham a mesma essência:
o toque humano e o respeito pelo sabor.Estamos presentes em lojas físicas (de rua, shoppings e quiosques) e meio digital, com e-commerce e delivery próprios. Levamos nossos produtos a empresas, grêmios e parceiros por meio do modelo store in store. Expandimos fronteiras com o B2B, atendendo projetos especiais como white label, L’Atelier e distribuidores nos Estados Unidos. E ainda colocamos a experiência na rua, com o Truck — nossa confeitaria sobre rodasSeja no balcão de uma loja, no ambiente corporativo ou na tela do celular, nosso compromisso é o mesmo:
entregar algo que vá além do esperado. Algo que inspire, que emocione e que alimente conexões.Missão & ValoresTrabalhar com dedicação para servir produtos gostosos de alta qualidade e gerar momentos de prazer todos os dias.? Vivemos nossos valores todos os dias:
- Vontade de crescer:
aprendemos, evoluímos, nos desafiamos.- Inovação para encantar:
respeitamos o passado, sem medo de inventar o novo.- Amor pelo que faz:
a paixão é o nosso ingrediente mais presente.- Feito por pessoas, com alma e coração:
o toque humano está em tudo que fazemos.Nossas Competências- Comunicação:
transmite ideias e informações de forma clara, mantém o tom de voz adequado ao ambiente.- Inovação:
busca ampliar ou atualizar os conhecimentos, trazendo novas ideias e maneiras de realizar o trabalho.- Inteligência Emocional:
tem atitude positiva e com foco na resolução do problema.- Liderança:
lidera projetos e pessoas de forma inspiradora para atingir resultados que contribuam para o crescimento da Ofner.- Experiência do Cliente:
mostra interesse, antecipa e responde rapidamente às necessidades do cliente.- Foco na qualidade:
realiza de forma precisa e criteriosa suas atividades, atendendo os padrões de qualidade esperados.- Foco em resultado:
demonstra facilidade e domínio nas atividades do dia a dia e no uso das ferramentas necessárias da área.- Cultura:
está integrado ao time, as atribuições do cargo, as normas e políticas da empresa.Números que contam histórias+1.000 colaboradores entre lojas, fábrica e escritório.+70 mil produtos produzidos por dia.3 milhões de panetones produzidos em 2024 (entre B2C e B2B).11 mil clientes recebidos por dia em nossas lojas.25 toneladas de grãos de café preparados por nossos baristas ao longo do ano.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Especialista Em Lean Construction
description:
O Especialista em Lean Construction será responsável por implementar e otimizar práticas de Lean Construction em todos os projetos da companhia, visando aumentar a eficiência, reduzir desperdícios e melhorar a qualidade nos processos de construção.Principais atividades:
Visitas Técnicas às Obras:
Realizar visitas regulares a todas as obras da companhia, acompanhando a aplicação dos princípios de Lean Construction no dia a dia das equipes de trabalho. Garantir que os processos estejam sendo seguidos corretamente e que as melhorias contínuas sejam implementadas;
Apoio às Equipes de Campo:
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de obra, fornecendo orientação e suporte na aplicação das metodologias Lean, como o mapeamento de fluxo de valor, o sistema pull, Kanban, entre outros. Auxiliar na resolução de problemas e garantir a execução das atividades com foco na redução de desperdícios;
Monitoramento de Desempenho:
Acompanhar os indicadores de performance das obras, analisando e identificando áreas para melhorias. Monitorar o progresso das metas estabelecidas, garantindo a redução de custos, o aumento da produtividade e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos;
Elaboração de Relatórios de Resultados:
Gerar relatórios periódicos detalhados sobre o desempenho das obras, com base nos indicadores de Lean Construction, destacando os resultados obtidos, as melhorias implementadas e as oportunidades para novas otimizações. Apresentar esses relatórios para a gestão da companhia;
Treinamento e Capacitação:
Promover treinamentos contínuos para as equipes operacionais e de gestão, com foco na disseminação dos conceitos de Lean Construction e na melhoria contínua das operações. Garantir que todos os membros da equipe estejam atualizados sobre as melhores práticas e ferramentas disponíveis;
Análise de Processos e Fluxos:
Realizar análises detalhadas dos processos de construção em andamento, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções para otimização. Implantar melhorias nas etapas do processo, desde o planejamento até a execução, sempre com foco em agregar valor e eliminar desperdícios;
Implementação de Projetos Piloto:
Desenvolver e implementar projetos piloto para testar novas metodologias e ferramentas de Lean Construction, promovendo a inovação e o aprimoramento contínuo no processo construtivo;
Gestão de Projetos deMelhoria:
Coordenar e acompanhar projetos de melhoria contínua nas obras, utilizando ferramentas do Lean, como Kaizen, 5S, entre outras, para promover a mudança cultural e operacional nas equipes;
Acompanhamento deResultados:
Realizar o acompanhamento diário dos resultados das obras, ajustando planos e propondo soluções para atingir as metas de performance, prazo e custo;
Integração com a Gestãoda Obra:
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os gestores das obras, fornecendo insights estratégicos sobre o uso de Lean Construction e alinhando as metas da obra com as práticas Lean para otimização dos resultados.Requisitos:
Pós-graduação ou certificações específicas em Lean Construction (Lean Six Sigma, Certificação em Lean Construction ou cursos de especialização);
Experiência prática na implementação de Lean Construction em projetos reais;
Participação ativa emprojetos Lean, com a aplicação das ferramentas como Kanban, Kaizen, Sistema Pull, Value Stream Mapping, 5S, e outras práticas de melhoria contínua;
Experiência em mapearemelhorar processos de construção, identificando gargalos e implementando soluções;
Habilidade comprovadaem analisar indicadores de performance e gerenciar KPIs para otimizar a produção e reduzir custos;
Experiência na liderança de equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo engenheiros, mestres de obra e operários, com foco em resultados e melhoria contínua;
Habilidade paratreinar e capacitar equipes nas práticas Lean e promover uma cultura de colaboração e eficiência.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Metro Arquitetos
description: Martin Corullon trained as an architect at the Faculty of Architecture and Urbanism at the University of São Paulo (FAUUSP). He holds a Masters degree from the same institution. He founded METRO ARQUITETOS ASSOCIADOS in the year 2000. Since 1994 he has been a close collaborator of Paulo Mendes da Rocha. During 2008 and 2009, he worked at Foster+Partners in London.Gustavo CedroniGustavo Cedroni qualified as an architect at FAAP in 2000. He worked with Pedro Paulo de Melo Saraiva in 1999 and with Eduardo Colonelli in 2000. He became a collaborator at METRO ARQUITETOS ASSOCIADOS and became a partner in 2007. He participated in the Architecture Biennale of Venice with a video installation in 2006 and taught at the European Institute of Design in São Paulo in 2010. In 2012, he worked with Rem Koolhaas’s OMA in NY.Practice IdeologyFounded in the city of São Paulo in 2000, METRO is an architecture studio active across a range of scales, from temporary exhibitions and installations to master planning and urban interventions. The office operates at a high level of technical rigor and research, seeking to promote connections between the work and its context, and to support the collective use of both public and private spaces. Directors Martin Corullon, Gustavo Cedroni and Marina Ioshii have a wealth of experience in projects across institutional, commercial and cultural sectors and experience at the international offices of Foster + Partners in London and OMA in New York.Clients include the São Paulo Biennale Foundation, Sesc, Nestle, Votorantim, Leme and Triângulo Gallery, The Moreira Salles Institute and at The São Paulo Museum of Art (MASP) where they remain a key part of the design team. Other projects include urban interventions like the Ladeira of Barroquinha in Salvador. Most recently they have partnered with Paulo Mendes da Rocha (Pritzker Prize and Golden Lion Award) designing Aesop’s first Brazilian store and are responsible for the expansion project for the campus at The Insitute of Aeronautical Technology in São José Dos Campos, recently completed. title: Principal Delivery Consultant - Ai/Ml, Professional Services
description:
Principal Delivery Consultant - AI/ML, Professional ServicesJoin to apply for the Principal Delivery Consultant - AI/ML, Professional Services role at Amazon Web Services (AWS)Principal Delivery Consultant - AI/ML, Professional Services1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicantsJoin to apply for the Principal Delivery Consultant - AI/ML, Professional Services role at Amazon Web Services (AWS)DescriptionThe Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.DescriptionThe Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.Key job responsibilitiesAs an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needsProviding technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project deliveryCollaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategiesActing as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologiesSharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifactsAbout The TeamDiverse Experiences:
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.Mentorship & Career Growth - We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.Basic Qualifications8+ years of experience in cloud architecture and implementation.Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.1+ year experience working with technologies related to large language models including LLM architectures, model evaluation, adapters, model customization including pre-training and fine-tuning techniques.7+ years professional experience in software development in languages related to ML like Python or Java. Experience working with RESTful API and general service-oriented architecture as well as to machine learning, deep learning, NLP, CV, GNN, or distributed training.10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.G. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience.Preferred QualificationsAWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.G.;

title: Como Associado Ou Consultor Associado (Prática De Risco, Investigações E Análise)
description:
Como Associado ou Consultor Associado (Prática de Risco, Investigações e Análise)A Charles River Associates tem sido, há mais de 50 anos, uma empresa pioneira de consultoria que oferece aos funcionários um ambiente para colaborar e aprender com um grupo diversificado de consultores, especialistas do setor e acadêmicos. Na CRA, você se juntará a mentes líderes que usam análises econômicas, financeiras, técnicas e de negócios para resolver problemas complexos para uma lista impressionante de clientes, incluindo 99% dos 100 maiores escritórios de advocacia, 89% das empresas da Fortune 100 e agências governamentais em todo o mundo. A CRA oferece um ambiente colaborativo, com equipes que buscam a excelência do cliente, trazendo curiosidade, desenvoltura e iniciativa ao seu trabalho. Através de um ambiente colegiado, oportunidades de treinamento formais e informais, e uma ampla gama de recursos de desenvolvimento profissional, sua experiência na CRA abrirá portas para você à medida que você acelera sua carreira.Visão geral do trabalhoComo Associado ou Consultor Associado, você apoiará a equipe sênior na realização de avaliações de risco de compliance, investigações contábeis forenses, pesquisa e análise de grandes volumes de dados. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com colegas no Brasil, nos Estados Unidos e na Europa, sendo fundamentalmente responsável pelo trabalho realizado pela equipe no Brasil.Você será responsável por tarefas relacionadas a pesquisa, investigações financeiras, litígios e questões de disputa. As responsabilidades podem incluir (mas não se limitam a):
Investigar e analisar registros financeiros e contábeis em apoio a investigações financeiras, como apropriação indébita de ativos, corrupção ou fraude nas demonstrações financeiras.Realizar procedimentos contábeis forenses em investigações multidisciplinares que envolvem pesquisas de antecedentes, conjuntos de dados complexos e análises técnicas contábeis ou econômicas.Utilizar históricos econômicos, contábeis e financeiros para apoiar especialistas seniores.Preparar e apresentar materiais relacionados a propostas e reuniões com clientes.Participar de iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios e práticas.Apoiar a administração diária de compromissos, incluindo execução de planos de trabalho, orçamento e faturamento.Revisar e resumir documentos de clientes, depoimentos, documentos legais, relatórios de analistas e dados financeiros para identificar informações-chave relevantes ao projeto.Auxiliar na criação, desenvolvimento e controle de qualidade das entregas ao cliente, incluindo análises financeiras, resumos de pesquisas, laudos periciais e outros materiais.QualificaçõesBuscamos candidatos para apoiar nossas crescentes ofertas de investigações. Os candidatos ideais devem possuir:
De 2 a 4 anos de experiência relevante em contabilidade forense ou áreas relacionadas.Fluência em português e inglês, pois essa pessoa interagirá frequentemente com escritórios internacionais.Graduação em áreas relacionadas, como administração, direito ou contabilidade, com experiência prévia em consultoria sendo preferencial. Certificações profissionais são um diferencial, mas não obrigatórias.Vontade de atuar em um ambiente empreendedor.Habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e excelente comunicação oral e escrita.Capacidade de priorizar tarefas, gerenciar múltiplos fluxos de trabalho, atenção aos detalhes e cumprimento de prazos.Alto nível de iniciativa, curiosidade, ética de trabalho e dedicação à qualidade.Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você terá contato frequente com a liderança sênior e colaborará com sua equipe.#J-18808-Ljbffr

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais:
Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.O que esperar de nós:
Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam:
Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!Nosso Cliente:
Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande empresa nacional do segmento de construção, infraestrutura, investimento e imobiliário.O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:
Projeto de migração das interfaces do SAP PI (Process Integration) para o SAP BTP IS (Integration Suite). Com o encerramento do suporte oficial ao SAP PI previsto para 2027, buscamos um(a) consultor(a) que será responsável por executar a migração dessas interfaces, garantindo continuidade, performance e aderência às melhores práticas da nova plataforma.Planejar e executar a migração de interfaces do SAP PI para BTP IS;
Garantir a integridade e funcionalidade das interfaces após a migração;

Documentar processos e soluções implementadas;
Realizar testese ajustes conforme necessário.O que você precisa ter:
Experiência comprovada em SAP PI/PO;
Conhecimento naplataforma SAP BTP IS (Integration Suite);
Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma e colaborativa;
Boa comunicaçãoe proatividade para trabalhar com times multidisciplinares.Será um diferencial interessante:
Caso consiga atuar em regime híbrido em São Paulo ou em Curitiba.Onde você vai trabalhar?Buscamos preferencialmente por profissionais que possam atuar em modelo híbrido (São Paulo ou Curitiba), mas não se limitando a isto, com possibilidade de atuar remotamente.

We currently have a team of almost one thousand and five hundred associates, but we continue to grow exponentially and look for new talents who are interested in a career opportunity in one of the largest IT companies in the world.We operate on several fronts:

As an SAP PS Consultant, you will play a key role in the successful implementation, maintenance, and optimization of SAP Project System functionalities. Your expertise in SAP Project System master data, financial concepts, and integration with other SAP modules will be instrumental in achieving our project goals.ResponsibilitiesSAP PS Configuration:
Configure and maintain SAP Project System master data and transactional data, including Project Definitions and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) structures in s4 HANA. Assist in data migration projects related to SAP PS.Results Analysis:
Utilize your working knowledge of Results Analysis and financial concepts to support project cost and revenue analysis, ensuring accurate financial reporting.Financial Integration:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and demonstrate a strong understanding of finance concepts. Work on business documentation related to financial aspects within SAP PS. Ensure seamless integration with SAP FICO modules.Integration with Other SAP Modules:
Establish and maintain robust integration between SAP PS and other SAP modules, with a particular focus on FICO, SD, and HR (CATS). Identify opportunities for process improvement and optimization.CostRevenue Planning:

title: Principal Consultant (Hybrid)
description:
Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new-generation energy markets.Fastmarkets' data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. Fastmarkets is a global business with a history dating back to 1865 and is built on trust and deep market knowledge. It has more than 600 employees spread across global locations in the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Finland and beyond.Job DescriptionThe RoleThis is an exciting opportunity for a candidate eager to help leading companies and market participants by delivering custom consulting engagements that enable our clients to thrive in volatile commodity markets.The Principal Consultant will focus on leading and delivering custom consulting and research projects that span the agriculture, forest products and metals, mining and minerals industries. Specifically, you will lead and deliver projects that include tailored market overviews and outlooks, feasibility assessments and analysis, industry cost modelling and analysis, supply-chain mapping and material sourcing strategies, and other bespoke engagements.You will be joining a dynamic global team dedicated to analysing and forecasting agriculture, forest products and metals, mining and minerals markets. You will leverage Fastmarkets’ existing data, insights and analyst team as an integral component of our consulting delivery.The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced and innovative environment, have a can-do attitude and can juggle a wide variety of tasks and projects.ResponsibilitiesWinning, executing, and project managing (both independently and in collaboration with our delivery teams) a range of commodity-related market consultancy projects across agriculture, forest products and metals commodity verticals.Managing the development and delivery of consultancy projects with a strong onus in meeting client time deadlines in providing strategic, due diligence, and general market/price forecasting services to major global commodity-related clientsManaging and supporting consultancy deliverables (self-sufficiently and managing others) that is robust, accurate, and well-researched and project managing resources utilizing modelling, data collection, and research interview techniquesDeveloping and supporting sales strategies to execute effective implementation of sales methodologiesDeveloping and building existing customer relationships and acquiring new consultancy customers, as well as repeat businessWillingness to be responsible for the complete sales cycle (end-to-end) when neededProcessing of tenders both independently and in cooperation with our delivery teamsCreating "customized" detailed pitch decks and individualized offers utilizing strong technical knowledge of the commodity marketsForecasting and CRM reportingParticipate in events and sales/marketing activities with a focus on existing and potential client business opportunitiesUtilize professional network to surface opportunities and to source independent contractors to support delivery of engagements.QualificationsExperience and skills required10+ years of consulting experience in commodities researchStrong acumen and desire for business development is essentialAbility and experience in managing, conducting, and researching commodity market studies both self-sufficiently, as well as with members of a team often not located in the same officeExperience in complex solution selling and project execution/management involving single-client consultancy services workExperience in project and client relationship management across varying market sectors and customer profilesExperience in developing and executing strategies for growth and high work-quality attainmentStrong commercial focus with good understanding from working with stakeholders at C-levelFluent in English, a second language preferredFlexibility and willingness to travel when requiredAn already established client and industry contact network would be desirableSelf-starter and ‘hunter’ mentality with strong personal drive is essential, with the ability to thrive in a multitasking environmentAccountable and performance-drivenEffective communication in person, on the phone, in writing and onlineEffective and amiable team player keen on making clients, project members, and colleagues happy while achieving ambitious objectives.Additional InformationFastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:
METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performanceACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with:
we keep our promises and get things doneGROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgencyINCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we doCOLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you!If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process:
it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day.It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.#J-18808-Ljbffr

About Our Team The WW eCommerce team at Lenovo manages Lenovo.Com, enabling direct transactions for end-users and small businesses in 38 countries worldwide. Within this team, the Global Customer Care & Support organization drives Lenovo's vision to provide world-class post-purchase support, ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction and retention. We are a group of passionate customer advocates who interact with hundreds of thousands of consumers and small businesses, playing a critical role in driving consistent double-digit growth year after year. What You’ll Do As the Manager of Brazil Customer Care Operations, you will oversee management of Brazil’s customer care function. You will be responsible for implementing strategic goals and ensuring Lenovo.Com delivers best-in-class post-purchase support for eCommerce customers. This role is essential to scaling and optimizing Lenovo’s customer support capabilities for the online channel of the world’s #1 PC manufacturer. Key responsibilities will include driving continuous improvement of our customer care strategy, assessing operational gaps, and ensuring adherence to core operational metrics to ensure customer service delivery. You will collaborate globally to implement new strategies, technologies, and best practices, contributing to our goal of offering exceptional customer support across all regions. This is a high-impact role for a creative, results-driven leader ready to take on the challenge of shaping world-class customer support operations at Lenovo.Com in Brazil. Lead Post-Purchase Support Operations :
Own and manage the customer care operations in Brazil, ensuring seamless post-purchase experiences for eCommerce customers. Support Business Management System (BMS) :
Drive the success of core KPIs (e.G., CSAT/OSAT, first-time resolution, aged backlog) by optimizing processes and managing performance. Standardize Global Best Practices :
Drive the implementation of industry best practices across global customer support functions, including supplier contract negotiations and KPI alignment. Identify and Solve CX Pain Points :
Collaborate with IT and regional teams to resolve customer experience issues based on priority. Tool and Process Improvement :
Guide the selection and implementation of tools and systems that enhance customer care operations, ensuring continuous process improvement. Advocate for Best Practices :
Evangelize post-purchase customer care best practices across all customer touchpoints. Technology and Data Management :
Identify and address gaps in technology, data, or platforms that could impact the success of customer support operations and testing strategies. Foster Internal and External Relationships :
Build and nurture strong partnerships to drive alignment and achieve business goals. Promote Ethical Standards :
Cultivate an environment of integrity and ethics where all team members adhere to company standards. What We’re Looking For As an experienced leader in post-purchase customer support, you will bring:
Expert Knowledge of Post-Purchase Support :
In-depth experience with post-purchase support strategies and tactics, with a focus on customer satisfaction and retention. Strategic Thinking & Execution :
Proven ability to assess performance gaps, define growth strategies, and drive results across teams. Data-Driven Leadership :
Strong understanding of KPIs and ability to drive meaningful, measurable improvements in customer care operations. Industry Best Practices Knowledge :
Familiarity with customer care best practices both within eCommerce and across adjacent industries. Multitasking & Execution :
